thread:
anna (PM): Acme legal escalated: they need team-level role checks + immutable audit trail before pilot sign. WFH: they want a short checklist we can hit this week.

mike (ENG): full RBAC + admin console is a month-plus. but we can implement a Role-lite layer: map IdP groups -> teams, enforce 2 roles (admin/member), and record events.

lina (SEC): audit trail needs tamper-evidence and export. For pilot we can provide append-only event logs + S3 export hook, full SIEM integration is v1.

rita (UX): admin console for mapping could be a thin modal that lets you confirm group->team mappings. No full RBAC UX yet.

sam (SRE): retention policy: default 30d for pilot logs. We'll add retention config and longer-term storage in v1. Also recommend per-tenant feature-flag.

alex (AE): Acme expects a firm delivery window or they pull pilot. They'll accept a staged approach if we give testable acceptance criteria.

anna (PM): proposal: ship MVP on schedule with Role-lite + audit export, gated behind tenant feature-flag. Commit to full RBAC + admin console within 60 days of pilot start. Add ACs for acceptance testing. Vote?

mike (ENG): +1. we'll need a small spike for schema and tests (Okta, OneLogin). estimate: 6 engineer-days to get Role-lite + logs working.

lina (SEC): +1 if we include signed event checks (HMAC) and S3 export with ACLs. That meets compliance for pilot.

rita (UX): +1. I'll design a minimal mapping modal and a clear "Pilot limitations" banner.

sam (SRE): operationally fine. will add runbook steps and sanity checks for export.

anna (PM): consensus = ship Role-lite as pilot unblock. Action items and ACs below.

Action items (owner -> due):
- anna -> draft pilot amendment with delivery window (60d) and acceptance criteria (today).
- mike -> Role-lite adapter + feature-flag; PR to staging (5 working days).
- lina -> event signing + S3 export template + compliance note (3 working days).
- rita -> mapping modal + pilot banner copy (3 working days).
- sam -> retention defaults, runbook, and alert on failed exports (5 working days).
- alex -> confirm Acme will accept these ACs and circulate for signature (EOD).

Acceptance criteria (ACs) for pilot sign:
1) IdP group mappings can be configured for tenant X via modal or CLI.
2) Role-lite enforcement: users receive admin/member permissions consistent with mapping.
3) Append-only event log produced for auth and role events; HMAC signed and exportable to S3.
4) Per-tenant feature flag gated, with ability to rollback.
5) Demo run with Okta and OneLogin proving mapping and export.

Day 60: full RBAC + admin console delivery window

rita (UX): agreed. will use "Pilot team controls" in copy + link to roadmap item for full RBAC.
